desc: Derive the doubled-state graph representation and verify that reversal parity fully captures all effects of repeated global reversals.
Implement implicit-state Dijkstra with outgoing/incoming adjacency lists and 64-bit-safe distances.
Validate movement and parity-toggle transitions against all sample cases.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python implementation using `heapq`.
Confirm the intended complexity is `O((N + M) log N)` and that answers can exceed 32-bit range.
